title: Gold, Silver Rates Today: Gold, silver prices rebound; MCX gold rate rises above  ₹1.48 lakh, silver prices jump 1% | Stock Market News
summary: Gold and silver prices in India initially fell but later recovered, trading higher due to steady global bullion prices and a weaker dollar. However, gold prices have seen a significant monthly decline due to a stronger dollar and inflation concerns, while silver prices have plunged due to sustained pressure from the US-Iran conflict.
sentiment_reason: The market is negatively impacted by the steep decline in gold prices due to a stronger dollar and inflation concerns, despite some recovery in India, and the significant drop in silver prices due to geopolitical tensions and market volatility.
